question: Does the exact P5F cross-layer correction remain deterministic, bounded and severe-artifact-clean when added after the retained P5C developed-density correction on the frozen P5D photographic OOD cohort?

input.domain_use: relative-display-sRGB-derived pseudo-exposure for structural and severe-artifact stress only

pipeline.baseline: exact P5C bounded independent-channel adjacency inside the frozen P5D chain
pipeline.candidate: exact P5C followed by exact P5F cross-layer developed-density correction before unchanged dye diffusion, transmittance interpretation and scanner MTF
pipeline.required_combined_halo: sum of frozen P5D spatial halo and P5F five-pixel halo
pipeline.output_quantization: diagnostic PNG only after all float64 metrics

severe_vetoes: red, green or blue speckle and posterization
objectionable colour fringing or edge echo
banding, clipping or flat-region colour blocks

forbidden_fallbacks: change P5C, P5D or P5F parameters, order, cohort or thresholds
retune the cross-layer matrix or bounds after viewing results
use visual review after automatic failure
treat pseudo-exposure as scene exposure or the result as a measured film process
promote the operator into production from this safety audit alone

branch_rule.pass: retain photographic severe/OOD development evidence and freeze a separate combined-chain value ablation
branch_rule.fail: close P5F for photographic use and retain unchanged P5C
